name: Paragraphs Summary Formatter
description: This formatter provides an additional formatter for paragraphs fields.
project_description:
This formatter provides an additional formatter for paragraphs fields. It has more settings than the default one:

 
 Choose which paragraphs bundles are allowed to be displayed 
 Choose view mode for paragraphs items 
 Limit the number of displayed paragraphs items
